captions_note: the chart sits on the wall behind the speaker, so the reel's captions stay on and carry the words (built with CAPTIONS=0: no tag on the chart)
in_a_reel: keep PUNCH = 1.0 and GRADE = 'none' (the reel owns the look and the slot must hand back unmoved footage at both edges)
start the slot at least 1 s before the KICK word and leave 1.5 s or more after it. The chart is gone before the slot ends unless the slot ends on a cut or at the end of the reel
FIGURES, X_LABELS and TAG stay off unless the buyer gives real ones: never invent, estimate or round up a number. The default is a shape, not a claim
steps: run measure.py      # words with measured start frames, where the speaker is, camera still or moving (about 1 minute)
edit the CLIP block in build.py: KICK at least. FIGURES, X_LABELS and TAG stay off unless the speaker gave real ones
run build.py SAFE=1 CAPTIONS=0      # prints kick frame, where the chart sits, clearances, every warning starts with !!
hf snapshot --at 1.2,3.0,3.6      # use your own times: mid draw, kick + 0.15 s, landing + 0.3 s
run build.py CAPTIONS=0      # guide off (it must print "clean")
run check.py      # frame count, plain first and last frame, kick frame against the word, sound level, sheet, stills, phone copy
